cardiometabolic-trajectories-before-deme.body:
# cardiometabolic trajectories before dementia 2018

Incidence-density nested case-control study within the French population-based Three-City (3C) cohort of persons aged 65+, comparing 785 incident dementia cases with 3140 matched controls on latent-process mixed-model trajectories of cardiometabolic risk factors up to 14 years before diagnosis. map3k15-diabetes-target-2022.body:
# map3k15 diabetes target 2022

Exome-wide gene-level collapsing association study of 454,796 UK Biobank exomes (discovery: 394,692 European participants, 33,788 diabetes cases) testing protein-coding variant associations with diabetes and related traits. Recessive loss-of-function variants in the X-linked gene MAP3K15 conferred ~30-35% reduced odds of diabetes and lower HbA1c/glucose independent of BMI, replicated in the Mexico City Prospective Study and FinnGen, identifying MAP3K15 as a candidate therapeutic target.

- **study design**: Multi-ancestry exome sequencing gene-level collapsing analysis and single-variant ExWAS with two independent replication cohorts
- **year**: 2022

Narrative review describing a holistic, patient-centric framework for identifying and validating drug targets in chronic kidney disease (CKD), integrating human omics big data, in silico systems biology and machine learning, and experimental validation across in vitro, ex vivo, and in vivo model systems.
